name: What is the difference between a car accident lawyer and a personal injury lawyer?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between a car accident lawyer and a personal injury lawyer?

acceptedAnswer.text: While often used interchangeably, a car accident lawyer is a type of personal injury lawyer who specializes specifically in cases involving vehicle collisions. A personal injury lawyer has a broader practice area, handling various types of injury cases, such as slip and falls, dog bites, or product liability. For car accidents, choosing a lawyer with specific expertise in that area ensures specialized knowledge.
acceptedAnswer.description: A car accident lawyer specializes in vehicle collisions, while a personal injury lawyer handles a broader range of injury cases; car accident lawyers offer specialized expertise.
